title: The specified geometric field comparison preserves coefficient coordinates
statement: For every prime ell and arbitrary embedding i:K -> Kprime of algebraically closed fields, let f=Spec(i), A=condensedRingObj(Qbar_ell,Spec K), and Eprime be terminal evaluation at Spec Kprime. The inverse fieldCoefficientIso(K,ell), followed by geometricFieldEvaluationComparison(f) at A, equals the inverse fieldCoefficientIso(Kprime,ell) followed by Eprime of inverse condensedPullbackHom(Qbar_ell,f). This statement involves the coefficient sheaf alone and no module or scalar-action assertion.

source.place: Section 4, finite-matrix refinement: presentation and geometric-fibre comparison after coefficient realization (steps 1--3)

proof.text: Evaluate both coordinate inverses on a scalar r and restrict to the singleton relative test object. The proved singleton normalization identifies both restricted values with the respective point-adjunction units applied to the same constant bounded function.

Apply terminal point-unit transport to the constant bounded function a and the inverse coefficient coordinates over both fields. The two proved singleton normalization theorems supply its hypotheses. Its conclusion gives the desired inverse coefficient square on the chosen scalar.
Every scalar has the constructed constant bounded representative, so extensionality of abelian-group morphisms gives the specified coefficient square.

lean.statement:
theorem condensedQbar_field_coefficient_square (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime]
    (K K' : Type u) [Field K] [IsAlgClosed K] [Field K'] [IsAlgClosed K']
    (i : K →+* K') :
    let f := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom i)
    let A := condensedRingObj (Profinite.padicAlgClRingObj ℓ) (Spec (.of K))
    let E' := sheafToPresheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology (Spec (.of K'))) Ab.{u + 1} ⋙
      (evaluation _ _).obj (op (Scheme.ProEt.mk (𝟙 (Spec (.of K')))))
    inv (CondensedQbarGeometricEvaluation.fieldCoefficientIso K ℓ).hom.hom ≫
      (geometricFieldEvaluationComparison f Ab).app A =
    inv (CondensedQbarGeometricEvaluation.fieldCoefficientIso K' ℓ).hom.hom ≫
      E'.map (inv (condensedPullbackHom (Profinite.padicAlgClRingObj ℓ) f))
